messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Smart routing policy triggered: traffic for customer AcmeCorp (EU residency) was routed to us-west-2 for ~12m. Rule mismatch between policy-version v12 and runtime policy cache. Auto-fallback engaged to "global/low-cost" variant. Severity: SEV2.

oncall-ryan: I'm on it. Started a quick check of routing config and recent deploys.

sre-ana: ETA to investigate ~10m. Ryan — can you capture the exact policy id and the fallback variant? I want to see if KV cache TTL expired.

oncall-ryan: Policy id: policy-eu-override-98. Active runtime hash: 0x7fc2 vs desired 0x8a21. Fallback variant: model-alias: "gen-4-small-global".

eng-maya: Looks like a rollout script we ran yesterday updated the default fallback map without applying residency guard. Pushing to reproduce locally.

security-lee: Heads up — potential data residency breach. Need containment steps and a quick customer impact estimate. Marking for security review.

pm-jordan: Notifying CS for customer comms. CS @cs-oliver will triage which tenants hit this.

cs-oliver: AcmeCorp is flagged in monitoring — 1,243 requests in the window. I'll prepare a customer note once we confirm no persisted data left the EU region.

incident-bot: Action log: created incident INC-1854, assigned oncall:oncall-ryan. Added tags: routing, data-residency, security.

sre-ana: Temporary mitigation applied: disabled automatic fallback in routing-policy service and set override to strict-residency for policy-eu-override-98. Command run: 

```
# disable auto-fallback
POST https://controlplane.internal/api/policies/policy-eu-override-98/actions
body: {"action":"set_fallback_mode","mode":"strict"}
```

oncall-ryan: Can confirm API returned 200 and runtime converged. Current runtime hash now matches desired 0x8a21 on all nodes (checked via /admin/runtime-hash).

eng-maya: Rolling back the incidental fallback map change that introduced the problem. CL 4729 reverted. Deploy status: SUCCESS on canary, rolling to remaining nodes.

security-lee: Forensics request: collect list of request ids, source IPs, and timestamps for the 12m window. Also snapshot logs for the model exec in us-west-2.

sre-ana: Running query to pull request IDs now, will attach to INC-1854. Quick summary: 1,243 requests, of which ~52 included customer-specified PII flags. We're classifying those — initial estimate: low persistence risk (no long-term storage), but data was processed outside EU briefly.

pm-jordan: We need status page update. Suggested blurb: "We detected a routing policy misconfiguration affecting EU residency for a subset of requests. We applied a mitigation to enforce residency and rolled back the change causing the issue. We're investigating impact and will follow up." Any objections?

cs-oliver: Sending targeted note to AcmeCorp now, offer to share logs and mitigation details.

security-lee: Initiating incident response checklist for data residency incidents. I'll raise a privacy hotline ticket and coordinate with legal.

oncall-ryan: Handoff: I'm going offline for 30m, handing to ana. Ana — key points: mitigation applied, rollback in-progress, security forensics kicked off, CS notified customer.

sre-ana: Acknowledged. I'll shepherd the remainder and keep updates in the thread. Current next steps: (1) finish log export, (2) verify no further misroutes, (3) run regression test for policy sync across control plane.

eng-maya: Added unit test to reject fallback mappings that override residency constraints. Will open PR for stricter CI checks.

incident-bot: Note: page suppressed for 20m while monitoring. If further misroutes detected, page again at SEV1.

security-lee: Quick ask — list of customers potentially affected? CS: AcmeCorp is confirmed. Ana/sre: can we query to ensure no other EU-flagged orgs were routed?

sre-ana: Query result: only AcmeCorp showed traffic pattern consistent with misroute in that timeframe. Cross-checked with tenant metadata.

pm-jordan: Scheduling postmortem: PM owner: jordan, SRE owner: ana, ENG owner: maya. Postmortem to include timeline, root cause (policy rollout missed guard), mitigations (CI check, runtime policy-sync monitoring), and customer comms plan.

cs-oliver: AcmeCorp responded: "Thanks for quick mitigation. Please keep us posted on whether any user data was persisted outside EU." I'm drafting a follow-up with logs and actions.

security-lee: After-action items assigned. Short-term: verify and redact any incidental logs with PII, ensure no backups left US region. Long-term: add strong residency assertion in control plane and enforce via schema.

oncall-ryan: Back online. All nodes report desired runtime hash. No new misroutes in the last 25m.

incident-bot: Closing note: incident remains open for postmortem and follow-up tasks. Recording timeline and artifacts in INC-1854.

sre-ana: Final immediate summary for thread: mitigation applied (disabled auto-fallback), rollback completed, security forensics underway, CS notified. Continuing investigation and will post postmortem within 72h.
